description: Compile captured sources into an insight note. The gate requires provenance back to every contributing source so the note is never detached from evidence.

expects.description: One or more captured source IDs have been selected for compilation. Each ID must resolve to an existing captured source record.
An insight note has been drafted that synthesises the selected sources. The note is not yet stored; this gate confirms the draft exists and is non-trivial.

The compiled insight note has been stored with provenance.source_ids listing every contributing captured source ID. Every source ref must be resolvable. No insight may be stored without traceable provenance to its sources.
